scenes.title: Back in five.
scenes.narration: A coffee shop. A little work. Then you need to step away. <#0.5#> Who's watching your laptop?

scenes.title: One request. Eyes on.
scenes.narration: Meet Torie-chan. <#0.3#> Hey Claude, can you watch my computer? <#0.25#> I've got to take a number two. <#0.4#> The countdown begins. Her eyes open. She's on guard.

scenes.title: Cute. Until it counts.
scenes.narration: People pass. She follows them with her eyes. Someone lingers, and her expression changes. <#0.3#> This laptop has company.

scenes.title: Hands off.
scenes.narration: Then a hand nudges the laptop. A spoken warning. <#0.5#> Lift it, and the alarm sounds through the Mac's built-in speakers.

scenes.title: An alarm. An alert.
scenes.narration: With phone alerts enabled, an iMessage reaches your iPhone. <#0.3#> An encrypted alarm photo stays on your Mac.

scenes.title: A guard. With boundaries.
scenes.narration: People detection happens on your Mac. No face recognition. No continuous recording. <#0.3#> Your agent can arm her. Only you can disarm her.

scenes.title: Your laptop. Your way back in.
scenes.narration: Come back. Use Touch ID or your code. She welcomes you, with a summary of what happened while you were away.

scenes.title: Small face. Big don't-touch energy.
scenes.narration: Torie-chan. <#0.5#> A little personality. A louder warning. <#0.4#> Back in five? She's got eyes on it.
